description: Amkor Technology is the largest Western-headquartered OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) provider, packaging finished silicon dies into the chips that power AI accelerators, smartphones, and automotive systems. The company is investing heavily in advanced packaging technologies — 2.5D, 3D stacking, and flip-chip — and is building a major domestic facility in Peoria, Arizona as part of the U.S. semiconductor reshoring effort. Q1 2026 revenue hit $1.685 billion (+27% YoY), with management guiding that its AI packaging portfolio would triple in the second half of 2026.
